jyutping: teng1 ho2 kaau3 siu1 sik1 gong2

english.note: Use this when reporting something said by a source that the speaker considers reliable, rather than describing how an action is performed.

examples.english: Credibly, the company will move next month.
examples.traditional: 聽可靠消息講，間公司下個月會搬。
examples.jyutping: teng1 ho2 kaau3 siu1 sik1 gong2 gaan1 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 bun1
